thresholds.near_duplicate_definition: Two explanations are near-duplicates when not exact-equal after normalization, but Jaccard similarity of reason-type sets ≥ 0.8. Reason types are category keys (budget, bedrooms, availability, commute, location, property_type, household, room, bathroom, lifestyle) derived from known preference-explanation templates. Exact duplicates: identical after trim + whitespace collapse + emoji/symbol strip.
